position_overview: Superside is looking for an Illustrator with a strong command of Generative AI to create exceptional work for some of the world's leading brands. You'll combine deep illustrative craft with AI-enhanced workflows to develop compelling visuals across campaigns, branding, editorial content, and digital experiences. Illustration is your core discipline. You bring strong visual storytelling skills, can work within established brand systems, and know how to use AI to expand creative possibilities while maintaining quality and consistency. What you'll do Create original illustrations across branding, campaigns, editorial content, social media, and digital experiences. Develop character-driven narratives, visual storytelling systems, and concept-led illustration work. Work within existing brand and illustration systems, matching established styles with consistency and accuracy. Use Generative AI tools to accelerate concept development, visual exploration, and illustration production. Integrate AI-generated assets into projects while maintaining strong artistic direction and brand integrity. Experiment with emerging AI workflows and share learnings with the broader creative team. Partner with creatives, project managers, and customers to translate briefs into polished visual outcomes. Connect illustration decisions to broader brand, campaign, and storytelling goals. Iterate quickly based on feedback while maintaining a high standard of craft. Manage multiple projects while balancing independent ownership and cross-functional collaboration. What you'll bring 5+ years of professional illustration experience with a portfolio showcasing strong conceptual and narrative work. Excellent drawing fundamentals, including anatomy, composition, perspective, form, and visual storytelling. Proven ability to work within established brand systems and illustration guidelines. Strong proficiency in Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, and related illustration tools. Experience using Generative AI tools as part of a professional creative workflow. Ability to create consistent illustration systems, character libraries, and scalable visual assets. Strong attention to detail and commitment to high-quality execution. Excellent English communication skills and ability to collaborate across distributed teams. Collaborative mindset with openness to feedback, iteration, and experimentation. Curiosity

Learn more at superside.com Diversity, Equity and Inclusion We're an equal-opportunity company. All applicants will be considered regardless of ethnicity, appearance, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, veteran or disability status.
